name: iteration-1-baseline
title: Iteration 1 — TypeScript baseline, runtime stability, first bundle cut
description: Iteration 1 of the Apex Cockpit redevelopment: move the app off CDN import maps onto a real Vite + TypeScript + React 19 toolchain, make the render loop and asset loading recoverable, take the first cut at the first-load payload, and back the whole thing with filled frontend specs and a seeded test suite. Parent owns the requirement set, the task map and the cross-child acceptance criteria; implementation happens in the four child tasks.
